Bibishana having spoken thus, Rams answered him saying :-
" 0 Thou, whose prowess is truth, I know the magic power of 
that barbarian; his knowledge of the Brahma Weapon endows 
that skilful and great magician with immense power so that he is 
able to deprive the Gods and Varuna himself of consciousness in 
combat I While he ranges the sky in his chariot, 0 ruustrious 
Prince, one is no more able to follow his course than that of the 
sun in the midst of heavy cloud I "
